avatars.visual: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent avatar portrait for a circular multiplayer game cell. Create the fifth character of an established fantasy avatar set: Звёздный лев, an anthropomorphic young lion bust, front three-quarter view looking slightly right, large head and shoulders, Royal theme: rich hand-painted fantasy game portrait, golden amber lion mane with flowing pointed tufts, cream muzzle, expressive emerald eyes, a modest navy blue shoulder mantle with gold edging and a small star medallion. Detailed painterly polished materials, rich warm color, readable silhouette, charming brave young lion, no crown, no faceted or crystalline fur. Composition crucial: square 1024x1024 canvas, head and BOTH ears and entire mane must fit inside an imaginary central circle of diameter 950px with comfortable margin; no horns or ears cut off. Upper silhouette contained within circular safety area. Shoulders and chest extend broad to bottom edge so a circular crop meets the lower boundary, no detached floating head. Do not draw the circle, frame, halo or backdrop. Actual transparent alpha background everywhere outside the character, no solid black or white background, no cast shadow, no vignette, no scenery, no text, no watermark. Render a single centered game-ready portrait, beautiful professional volumetric hand-painted illustrated aesthetic, easily recognizable at 64px.
